summary.oneLiner: Vadilal Enterprises is the sales, marketing and distribution arm of the Vadilal ice-cream franchise in India, targeting revenue of Rs 1,600 crore in 2026-27.
summary.business: The Company markets and distributes Vadilal-branded ice cream across India through a dealer and distributor network supported by trade schemes and retail engagement. Its go-to-market rests on an integrated ATL/BTL marketing model spanning TV, print, outdoor, radio, POS/POP branding, retail activations and a growing digital and OTT presence. Growth is being pursued by deepening penetration in Tier 2, Tier 3 and rural markets alongside the existing nationwide footprint.

endMarkets: India - nationwide consumer market|Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities|Rural markets

risks.risk: Rising raw material and input costs
risks.note: Explicitly listed by management as an ongoing challenge for the ice cream industry; dairy and other input inflation squeezes a business whose reported EBITDA is thin relative to revenue, and the Company relies on procurement planning and operational efficiencies to absorb it.

Ice cream distribution depends on an unbroken cold chain; management lists cold chain infrastructure requirements among the operational challenges, making product availability contingent on continuing investment in and reliability of freezing and cold storage capability.

Flagged by management as a market-related challenge; disruption in supply or distribution logistics directly threatens uninterrupted product availability, which the Company names as the thing its mitigation is meant to protect.
Management lists seasonality among the industry's challenges - ice cream demand is concentrated in the hot season, so a weak or shortened summer swings volumes and utilisation within the year.

risks.risk: Dependence on the Vadilal brand and related-party supply chain
risks.note: The business is a single-brand ice cream marketing and distribution operation; the related-party note shows goods purchased from Vadilal Industries Limited, royalty paid to Vadilal International Private Limited and a corporate guarantee / letter of comfort taken from Vadilal Industries Limited, so operations and brand rights sit with promoter-influenced entities rather than the Company itself.
